title: Florida Homes Held in Trust by County, 2026
subtitle: Trust-owned parcels, homesteads and land trusts from the 2026 FL tax roll
description:
For each of Florida's 67 counties, this dataset counts the real property parcels held in trust on the 2026 Florida Department of Revenue NAL property roll. It gives residential and homestead counts, just value, the kind of trust the owner name states (revocable, irrevocable, testamentary, land trust or unstated), whether one trustee or several are named, and land trusts separately from family trusts. Banks, companies and public bodies named as trustee are excluded.

Statewide, 600,542 residential parcels are held in trust (6.11% of 9,830,053), with a just value of $347.5 billion. 582,392 are in a family trust and 18,150 in a land trust. 270,615 trust parcels carry a homestead exemption. Collier leads at 19.15% of residential parcels in a family trust, followed by Sarasota, Lee, Indian River and Sumter.

Limits. The classification reads the owner name only, never the trust document. The name field is short and often truncated, so about 78% of trust parcels do not state revocable or irrevocable. Six counties (Alachua, Manatee, Baker, Clay, Gadsden and Citrus) record owner names without the trustee designation and undercount trusts; they are flagged in trust_designation_on_roll, and the statewide totals include them, so the true statewide figure is somewhat higher. Homestead means the parcel shows a homestead exemption value on the roll. The roll is the 2026 preliminary roll, except Citrus, which is final. Aggregates only, no owner names.

Canonical page and citation: https://stepuplaw.com/data/florida-homes-held-in-trust/
Source repository with the build script and findings: https://github.com/stepuplaw/florida-homes-in-trust-dataset
Author: Kevin D. Klagge, Klagge Law, PLLC, ORCID https://orcid.org/0009-0002-1385-8498

This is reference data, not legal advice.

resources.description: One row per Florida county, 67 rows

fields.name: county
fields.description: County name (67 Florida counties)

fields.name: parcels
fields.description: All real property parcels on the county roll

fields.name: trust_parcels
fields.description: Parcels whose owner name identifies a trust or a trustee, after excluding banks, companies and public bodies named as trustee. Includes land trusts

fields.name: pct_parcels_in_trust
fields.description: trust_parcels as a percentage of parcels

fields.name: trust_just_value
fields.description: Sum of just (market) value on the roll for trust_parcels, in US dollars

fields.name: residential_parcels
fields.description: Parcels with a Department of Revenue residential use code, 000 to 009 except 003 (vacant residential land, single family, mobile home, condominium, cooperative, retirement home, multifamily under 10 units and residential common elements)

fields.name: trust_residential_parcels
fields.description: Residential parcels held in trust, land trusts included

fields.name: pct_residential_in_trust
fields.description: trust_residential_parcels as a percentage of residential_parcels

fields.name: trust_homestead_parcels
fields.description: Trust parcels showing a homestead exemption value on the roll (JV_HMSTD greater than zero)

fields.name: kind_revocable
fields.description: Trust parcels whose owner name says revocable or living trust

fields.name: kind_irrevocable
fields.description: Trust parcels whose owner name says irrevocable

fields.name: kind_testamentary
fields.description: Trust parcels whose owner name says testamentary

fields.name: kind_land
fields.description: Land trusts (named land trust, numbered trust, or a title or land trust service company as trustee)

fields.name: kind_unstated
fields.description: Trust parcels whose owner name does not say what kind of trust it is

fields.name: trustees_single
fields.description: Owner name shows one trustee

fields.name: trustees_joint
fields.description: Owner name shows two or more trustees

fields.name: trustees_trust_named
fields.description: The trust itself is written as owner, with no trustee word

fields.name: land_numbered
fields.description: Land trusts identified by a trust number

fields.name: land_named
fields.description: Land trusts identified by the words land trust

fields.name: land_corporate_trustee
fields.description: Land trusts with a title company or land trust service company as trustee

fields.name: family_trust_parcels
fields.description: trust_parcels minus land trusts

fields.name: family_trust_residential_parcels
fields.description: trust_residential_parcels minus land trusts

fields.name: family_trust_homestead_parcels
fields.description: trust_homestead_parcels minus land trusts

fields.name: pct_residential_in_family_trust
fields.description: family_trust_residential_parcels as a percentage of residential_parcels

fields.name: trust_designation_on_roll
fields.description: recorded, or unreliable where the county roll writes the owner name without the trustee designation, so trusts are undercounted. Rule: pct_residential_in_family_trust below 1.0
